metrics.metric_name: Temporal Invariant: No Clinical Activity Prior to Birth
metrics.definition: Verifies that no clinical encounter or procedure occurs before the patient's recorded birth date.
metrics.known_limitations: Requires either explicit birth_date column or deterministic age projection.

metrics.metric_name: Temporal Invariant: Zero Post-Mortem Clinical Events
metrics.definition: Verifies that deceased patients have strictly zero subsequent encounters, orders, or prescriptions.
metrics.known_limitations: Evaluated against deaths.csv records.

metrics.metric_name: Causal Invariant: Diagnosis Must Link to Valid Clinical Encounter
metrics.definition: Conditions must be recognized and diagnosed during an active clinical encounter.
metrics.known_limitations: Requires foreign key condition.encounter_id -> encounters.encounter_id.

metrics.metric_name: Clinical Safety Invariant: Zero Contraindicated Prescriptions
metrics.definition: Verifies that no patient is prescribed a medication to which they have a documented allergy.
metrics.known_limitations: Evaluates allergy constraints against medication names.

metrics.metric_name: Temporal Invariant: Person-Time Bounded by Eligible Observation Duration
metrics.definition: Verifies that total cohort person-time does not exceed the sum of maximum eligible observation durations across all patients.
metrics.known_limitations: Evaluates individual and aggregated right-censored follow-up duration.

metrics.metric_name: Demographic Fidelity: Male Sex Proportion
metrics.definition: Percentage of cohort that is male compared to Census SRS 2021 reference.
metrics.known_limitations: Natural sex ratio in India is ~51.5% male. Small sample sizes may have higher random variance.

metrics.metric_name: Demographic Fidelity: Age Pyramid Jensen-Shannon Divergence
metrics.definition: JSD (base 2) between synthetic age distribution and SRS 2021 5-band reference pyramid.
metrics.known_limitations: Evaluated over 5 broad SRS census intervals. Small cohorts (<100) experience expected stochastic dispersion.

metrics.metric_name: Demographic Fidelity: Age-by-Sex Joint Distribution JSD
metrics.definition: Jensen-Shannon Divergence across 10 age-by-sex joint strata compared to SRS 2021 Statement 19.
metrics.known_limitations: Requires adequate cohort sample size across all 10 cells to avoid small-sample bin bias.

metrics.metric_name: Disease Prevalence: Essential Hypertension (Adults >= 20)
metrics.definition: Prevalence of essential hypertension (I10) among eligible adults (age >= 20) vs ICMR-INDIAB 2023.
metrics.known_limitations: Evaluates 2-year cumulative period prevalence. Baseline point prevalence at t=0 is isolated in acceptance_threshold.

metrics.metric_name: Disease Prevalence: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (Adults >= 20)
metrics.definition: Prevalence of Type 2 Diabetes (E11.9) among eligible adults (age >= 20) vs ICMR-INDIAB 2023.
metrics.known_limitations: Evaluates 2-year cumulative period prevalence. Baseline point prevalence at t=0 is isolated in acceptance_threshold.

metrics.metric_name: Disease Prevalence: Acute URTI 14-Day Point Prevalence (All Ages)
metrics.definition: 14-day recall point prevalence of active acute URTI (J06.9) vs NHP India 2020 baseline.
metrics.known_limitations: Requires filtering for active, non-resolved infection episodes within a 14-day evaluation window.

metrics.metric_name: Disease Attack Rate: Acute URTI 2-Year Cumulative Attack Rate (All Ages)
metrics.definition: 2-year cumulative attack rate of acute URTI (J06.9) across entire cohort vs NHP/IDSP surveillance baseline.
metrics.known_limitations: Cumulative attack rate over 24-month horizon. Derived from quarterly infection hazards.

metrics.metric_name: Comorbidity: Hypertension Prevalence in Patients with Type 2 Diabetes
metrics.definition: Conditional prevalence P(HTN|T2D) among adults >= 20 vs ICMR-INDIAB 2023 benchmark.
metrics.known_limitations: Evaluated strictly on adults with diagnosed T2D. If no synthetic patient develops T2D, status is NOT_APPLICABLE.

metrics.metric_name: Longitudinal: Encounters Per Patient-Year
metrics.definition: Average number of clinical encounters generated per patient-year of observation.
metrics.known_limitations: Facility discrete-event simulation captures scheduled outpatient visits and episodic visits.

metrics.metric_name: Longitudinal: Mean Days Between Clinical Encounters
metrics.definition: Mean interval in days between consecutive clinical encounters for multi-visit patients.
metrics.known_limitations: Clinical modules use configured surveillance delays (e.g., 90d, 180d, 365d).

metrics.metric_name: Longitudinal: Annualized Crude Mortality Rate
metrics.definition: Annual deaths per patient-year compared to Census SRS Abridged Life Table 2016-2020.
metrics.known_limitations: Short simulation windows (e.g. 2 years) in small cohorts exhibit expected binomial variance.

metrics.metric_name: Longitudinal: Treatment Intensification Rate
metrics.definition: Descriptive simulation rate: Cumulative proportion of treated chronic patients stepped up to dual therapy over 2 years.

acceptance_threshold.clinical_fidelity_classification: UNVERIFIED (Guideline rule conformance without clinical inertia; real-world cross-sectional prescribing target of 35% is not comparable to cumulative 2-year patient escalation)

metrics.known_limitations: High cumulative intensification (75-85%) reflects zero therapeutic inertia across repeated visits.

metrics.metric_name: Longitudinal: Chronic Complication Rate
metrics.definition: Rate of secondary target-organ damage (CKD, Nephropathy) emerging longitudinally in chronic patients.
metrics.known_limitations: Complications depend on discrete transition weights and surveillance visit frequencies. Classified UNVERIFIED because discrete Markov draws are not externally calibrated clinical trial incidence.

metrics.metric_name: Treatment Conformance: Algorithmic Guideline Rule Conformance (First-Line Antihypertensive Therapy)
metrics.definition: Percentage of diagnosed hypertension cases prescribed first-line CCB (Amlodipine) or ARB. Measures state machine algorithmic rule conformance.
metrics.known_limitations: Assumes uncomplicated stage 1/2 essential hypertension indicated for calcium channel blocker. Reflects algorithmic rule compliance rather than verified real-world prescribing fidelity (empirical real-world monotherapy alignment is ~45-65%).

metrics.metric_name: Treatment Conformance: Algorithmic Guideline Rule Conformance (First-Line Oral Hypoglycemic Therapy)
metrics.definition: Percentage of diagnosed Type 2 Diabetes cases prescribed first-line Biguanide (Metformin). Measures state machine algorithmic rule conformance.
metrics.known_limitations: Guideline recommends Metformin monotherapy as universal initial pharmacotherapy. Reflects algorithmic rule compliance rather than verified real-world prescribing fidelity (empirical real-world monotherapy alignment is ~50-60%).

metrics.metric_name: Treatment Pattern: Perfect Adherence Assumption Disclosure
metrics.definition: Formal disclosure documenting that simulated patient adherence to dispensed pharmacotherapy is 100%.
metrics.known_limitations: Real-world non-communicable disease medication adherence in India is ~40-60%. Simulation assumes 100% adherence.
